title: PRINCIPLES OF FINANCIAL ACCOUNTING
description: Imparts an understanding of the purpose of accounting, common financial statement items, and the principles of internal controls. Focuses on recording the impact of economic events on account balances using U.S. Generally Accepted Accounting Principles, and the creation and analysis of financial statements to aid in external decision making.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: MTH 111, 111Z, 241, 251Z, 251HZ, 251, 251H, minimum score of 060 in 'Math Placement - ALEKS' or minimum score of 24 in 'Math Placement Test'.
A minimum grade of C- is required in MTH 111, MTH 111Z, MTH 241, MTH 251Z, MTH 251HZ, MTH 251 and MTH 251H.

Enrollment is limited to students with a program in:

  • Supply Chain & Logistics Mgmt (075)
  • Business Administration (181)
  • Finance (182)
  • Business Information Systems (183)
  • Business Engineering (355)
  • Accountancy (641)
  • Marketing (799)
  • Agricultural & Food Bus Mgmt (897)
  • Business Analytics (899)
  • Accounting (A016)
  • Organizational Leadership (A018)
  • Innovation & Entrepreneurship (A039)
  • Sports Business (A050)
